frontier.description: Judgment-first guidance for a validated capable runtime or explicit selection.
guidance: Choose verification proportional to blast radius, reversibility, novelty, and evidence strength.
Keep small or sequential work inline unless delegation adds material independent value.
Do not add unconditional self-rechecks or verifier-only agents.

compatibility.description: Explicit scaffolding when runtime capability is unknown or invalid.
guidance: State RED or replacement evidence before behavior changes, then report focused and wider GREEN checks.
Use explicit task packets, response fields, review triggers, and completion evidence.
Do not default small tasks to fan-out or spawn a verifier without a selected review need.
